newsitem.title: USA: SFX terminates swap with EZ Comms.
newsitem.headline: SFX terminates swap with EZ Comms.

text.p: SFX Broadcasting Inc said on Wednesday that it has terminated its agreement with EZ Communications to exchange radio stations.

SFX said it was going to exchange its Charlotte, N.C. radio station WTDR(FM) and additional cash consideration for EZ's radio station WSSS(FM) and stations WRFX(FM) and WNKS(FM), all serving the same market.
The reasons for not reaching final agreement include the extended time period which EZ and Evergreen Media Corp, owner of WRFX and WNKS, took to reach their own agreement, SFX said.
SFX said current growth at its Charlotte stations was also a factor in ending the station swap deal.
SFX said it would not rule out a deal with Evergreen or EZ in the future.
